title: Phantom Ganon Guide · Castle 1-vs-5 and Overworld Solo Full Walkthrough · Tears of the Kingdom Guide
pairs: 王国之泪幻影加侬完全攻略，含战前准备、无伤清瘴气触手、真身三武器完美闪避打法、城堡五连战贤者战术，附魔王之弓与瘴气武器余料建造技巧。

Complete guide to Phantom Ganon in Tears of the Kingdom, covering pre-fight preparation, clearing Gloom tendrils without damage, perfect-dodge tactics against its true form's three weapons, Sage tactics for the castle's five-clone fight, and Fuse tips for the Demon King's Bow and Gloom weapons.
剧情Boss · 三步流程拆解 · 完美闪避与逃课双方案
Story Boss · Three-step breakdown · Perfect-dodge and cheese options
⚠ 瘴气伤害： 幻影加侬的攻击带有瘴气效果， 会永久扣除心心上限 。务必备好向阳草料理。
⚠ Gloom damage: Phantom Ganon's attacks carry a Gloom effect that temporarily reduces your maximum hearts (restorable with Sundelion meals). Be sure to have Sundelion meals ready.
准备料理（向阳草）： 采集 向阳草 （空岛很多）和肉类/蔬菜一起煮，做成带有"恢复瘴气"图标的料理。这能 治好你碎掉的心心上限 。
Prepare meals (Sundelions): gather Sundelions (plentiful on Sky Islands) and cook them with meat/vegetables into meals with the "Gloom recovery" icon. These can heal your shattered maximum hearts.
准备武器： 准备一把弓（如果有 三连弓、五连弓 更好）以及大量的 炸弹花 、 吉布得骨头 （堆面板伤害）。
Prepare weapons: bring a bow (a triple-shot or five-shot bow is even better) plus plenty of Bomb Flowers and Gibdo Bones (to stack listed damage).
抗瘴气装备： 如果有在地下兑换的 "暗黑套装" 或 "瘴气防护服" ，可以穿上增加容错率。
Gloom-resistant gear: if you have the "Dark Set" or "Gloom protection outfit" exchanged in the Depths, wear them to increase your margin for error.
🛑 第二步：白送的第一阶段——无伤清触手
🛑 Step 2: The Free First Phase — Clearing Tendrils Without Damage
掌握"空对地"原则，瘴气之手就是白送的
Master the "air-to-ground" principle, and the Gloom Hands are free
⚠ 很多人死在幻影加侬面前，其实是被瘴气之手抓死了。 只要掌握空对地原则，触手就是白送的。
⚠ Many people die before Phantom Ganon because the Gloom Hands grab them. As long as you master the air-to-ground principle, the tendrils are free.
寻找高地： 进场看到地上冒黑泥， 立刻找附近的台阶、石头、废墟或者墙壁往上爬 。
Find high ground: when you enter and see black sludge bubbling from the ground, immediately climb nearby steps, rocks, ruins, or walls.
触发林克时间（Bullet Time）： 从高处跳下来，在 半空中按住 ZR 拔弓 ，世界变慢。
Trigger bullet time: jump down from height and hold ZR to draw your bow midair — the world slows down.
疯狂轰炸： 把 炸弹花 或者宝石（红宝石/蓝宝石）附魔在箭上，往 触手堆的中心疯狂输出 。
Bombard wildly: fuse Bomb Flowers or gems (Ruby / Sapphire) onto arrows and pour damage into the center of the tendril cluster.
⚠ 注意： 必须要在短时间内把所有触手 全部炸死 ，如果留一只太久，死掉的触手会 复活 。
⚠ Note: you must blast all the tendrils dead within a short time — if one is left too long, dead tendrils will revive.
⚔️ 第三步：幻影加侬真身实战
⚔️ Step 3: Fighting Phantom Ganon's True Form
三种武器形态（剑/长枪/大棒）——两种方案任选其一
Three weapon forms (sword / spear / club) — pick either of two approaches
老实人打法——完美闪避（Flurry Rush）
The honest approach — perfect dodge (Flurry Rush)
幻影加侬的攻击前摇非常明显，按住 ZL 注视他，根据动作闪避即可：
Phantom Ganon's attack wind-ups are very obvious — hold ZL to focus on him and dodge according to his movements:
持剑形态： 横着举剑（蓄力斩）→ ZL + 摇杆后拉 + 跳（后跳） ，触发突击。
Sword form: holding the sword horizontally (charged slash) → ZL + stick back + jump (back hop) triggers a Flurry Rush.
竖着举剑或冲刺 → ZL + 摇杆左/右 + 跳（侧跳） ，触发突击。
Holding the sword vertically or dashing → ZL + stick left/right + jump (side hop) triggers a Flurry Rush.
长枪形态： 他会大跨步向前突刺。判定范围窄，直接 ZL + 向左或向右侧跳 ， 必出突击 。
Spear form: he takes a big stride forward to thrust. The hit zone is narrow — just ZL + side-hop left or right, and a Flurry Rush is guaranteed.
大棒（双手剑）形态： 攻击力极高还会跳起来砸地。 千万别用盾牌硬挡 （会在地上产生瘴气）。砸下来的瞬间 向后跳 ，躲开冲击波并触发突击。

Club (two-handed weapon) form: extremely high attack, and it leaps up to slam the ground. Never block it head-on with your shield (it leaves Gloom on the ground). The instant it slams down, jump backward to dodge the shockwave and trigger a Flurry Rush.
纯无脑逃课法——空中飞人流
Pure no-brainer cheese — the aerial acrobat approach
如果实在掌握不好闪避节奏，继续用对付触手的那招：
If you really can't get the dodge timing down, keep using the same trick as against the tendrils:
爬到高处（或用 通天术 到二楼平台），跳下来， 空中拔弓进入子弹时间 ，把 吉布得骨头 或 人马角 附魔在箭上，疯狂爆他的头。
Climb high (or use Ascend to reach a second-floor platform), jump down, draw your bow midair to enter bullet time, fuse Gibdo Bones or Lynel horns onto your arrows, and relentlessly headshot him.
连续爆头会让他陷入硬直，根本还不了手。
Repeated headshots will keep him staggered, unable to fight back at all.
⚠️ 城堡五连战（主线）特殊技巧
⚠️ Castle Five-Clone Fight (Main Quest) Special Tips
海拉鲁城堡主线"幻影加侬五连战"——同时出现多个分身
Hyrule Castle main quest "Phantom Ganon five-clone fight" — multiple clones appear at once
让贤者当肉盾： 进场直接把 阿布莱克（雷）、丘栗（风）、米法（水）、云坊（火） 等贤者分身全部召唤出来，让他们去 分散幻影加侬的注意力 。
Use the Sages as tanks: on entering, immediately summon all the Sage avatars — Riju (Lightning), Tulin (Wind), Sidon (Water), Yunobo (Fire) — and let them distract Phantom Ganon.
逐个击破： 你只需要盯着 一个没有防备的 ，或者正在释放地场瘴气的分身疯狂输出。
Pick them off one by one: you only need to focus on one clone that is off guard, or one that is spreading ground Gloom, and pour damage into it.
射击施法者： 第二阶段有的分身会在地上扩散瘴气， 只要用箭射一下他的头 ，他的施法就会被 打断 。
Shoot the caster: in the second phase, some clones spread Gloom on the ground — just shoot one arrow at its head and its casting will be interrupted.
魔王之弓： 你的 心心上限越多，这把弓的攻击力就越高 （后期能达到 60 点面板攻击 ），前期堪称神级武器。
Demon King's Bow: the more maximum hearts you have, the higher this bow's attack (up to 60 attack at 30 hearts) — it becomes a god-tier weapon once you have many hearts early on.
瘴气武器（剑/枪/大棒）： 攻击力非常高（通常在 40 左右）。虽然握在手里攻击会 腐蚀自己的心心 ，但完美的解决方法是：
Gloom weapons (sword / spear / club): very high attack (usually around 40). Although attacking while holding one erodes your own hearts, the perfect solution is:
用 余料建造 把瘴气武器合到其他普通武器上，既能获得高攻击力，又 完全不会扣血 ！
Use Fuse to attach a Gloom weapon to another ordinary weapon — you get the high attack and lose no health at all!
